name: HealthOrMedicalOrBiomedicalResearch
summary: The card component of Health or Medical or Biomedical Research (DUO_0000006). The requester's project intends to use the data for a health, medical or biomedical purpose the owner allows and for no purpose the owner prohibits, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

allowedPurposes.description: Purpose terms the owner allows (meant to be health/medical/biomedical purposes). An IntendedDataUseCredential needs at least one useOnlyFor.purposes entry in this list.

prohibitedPurposes.description: Purpose terms that disqualify an IntendedDataUseCredential (meant to be population-origins/ancestry purposes). An IDU with any useOnlyFor.purposes entry in this list is dropped.
